PROJECT BRIEF

Requirements with evidence.

RequirementStatusEvidence
WireframesImplementedRetrospective flow structure in Figma.
Brand, imagery, and descriptionsImplementedFablebrink identity and sixteen original fictional titles.
Film and series pagesImplementedEight films and eight series, separate collections, and format filtering.
Playback and trailer actionsImplementedTwo real animated previews, native controls, sound, saved progress, and explicit availability.
Figma interface and prototypeCurrent layouts and flowsFigma now includes a current website page with editable desktop and phone layouts, reusable cards and controls, and connected discovery, title, preview, and saved list paths. Earlier iterations remain in an archive. The browser is the functional reference for playback, filtering, and local saved state. Visual browser parity and assistive technology testing remain open.
Distinct visual directionImplementedEditorial curation, contrasting dark and light areas, serif title treatments, restrained lime actions, and cinematic motion.
Browser and assistive technology verificationOpenNo claim of completed browser QA or Section 508 compliance.
Participant researchOpenA session plan exists. Findings and measured outcomes require real sessions.

Honest boundaries

This is an independent streaming UX concept. It has no subscriptions, licensed full films, accounts, payments, or commercial streaming backend. Its playable previews are real generated animation. Its full catalog stories are fictional.
